program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (3.0, 1.5, 4.0),        # diff pair L
    "itail": (8e-6, 6e-6, 11e-6),    # tail current
    "L4":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror L
    "L7":    (0.6, 0.35, 1.2),       # 2nd stage PMOS driver L
    "gmid7": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # 2nd stage PMOS gm/Id
    "i7":    (28e-6, 20e-6, 32e-6),  # 2nd stage current
    "cc":    (1.4e-12, 0.9e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.2, 0.8, 2.5),        # Rz = rz_k*(1+CL/Cc)/gm7
    "Lb":    (3.0, 1.5, 4.0),        # bias/tail/M8 L
    "gb":    (16.0, 12.0, 19.0),     # bias gm/Id
    "vmarg": (0.07, 0.03, 0.15),     # Vsd7 margin above vdsat7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = spec.get("vdd", 1.8); vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it, i1, i7, cc = p["itail"], p["itail"] / 2, p["i7"], p["cc"]
    L4, L7 = p["L4"], p["L7"]
    icb = 2e-6                        # cascode bias branch current

    # ---- bias ----
    gb, Lb = p["gb"], p["Lb"]
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=0.65)
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=mb0.vgs)

    # ---- 2nd stage driver M7 + PMOS cascode M7C (bulk = own source) ----
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], L7, i7, vds=0.25)
    vsd7 = m7.vdsat + p["vmarg"]
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], L7, i7, vds=vsd7)
    mc = lut.size("p", 14.0, 0.5, i7, vds=max(vdd - vsd7 - vcm, 0.2), vsb=0.0)
    vbc_target = vdd - vsd7 - mc.vgs          # cascode gate voltage
    vgs_pb = vdd - vbc_target                  # diode Vsg needed
    vout1 = vdd - m7.vgs

    # PMOS diode (source vdd) generating vbc: bisection on gm/Id
    lo, hi = 3.0, 20.0
    for _ in range(30):
        g = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        mpb = lut.size("p", g, 1.0, icb, vds=vgs_pb)
        if mpb.vgs > vgs_pb:
            lo = g
        else:
            hi = g
    mpb = lut.size("p", 0.5 * (lo + hi), 1.0, icb, vds=vgs_pb)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, icb, vds=vdd - mpb.vgs)

    # ---- mirror: gm/Id so Vgs3 == Vgs7 ----
    lo, hi = 4.0, 24.0
    for _ in range(30):
        g = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        m3 = lut.size("p", g, L4, i1, vds=m7.vgs)
        if m3.vgs > m7.vgs:
            lo = g
        else:
            hi = g
    g3 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    m3 = lut.size("p", g3, L4, i1, vds=m7.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", g3, L4, i1, vds=vdd - vout1)
    vn1 = vdd - m3.vgs

    # ---- diff pair (with body effect) ----
    vs = 0.25
    for _ in range(5):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=max(vn1 - vs, 0.1), vsb=vs)
        vs = vcm - m1.vgs
    mt = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, it, vds=max(vs, 0.12))
    m8 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, i7, vds=vcm)

    gm7 = m7.gm
    rz = p["rz_k"] * (1 + CL / cc) / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MB1", "vbc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MPB", "vbc", "vbc", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "x7", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M7C", "vout", "vbc", "x7", "x7", mc)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m4.gds + m1.gds)
    g7eff = m7.gds * mc.gds / mc.gm
    A2 = gm7 / (g7eff + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    psrr_db = min(db(A1 * gm7 / g7eff) - 6, 115.0)
    cmrr_db = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (mt.gds * (m4.gds + m1.gds))) + 10
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd + 5e-15
    C2 = CL + m8.cdd + mc.cdd
    wp2 = gm7 * cc / (C1 * C2 + cc * (C1 + C2))
    wp3 = 1.0 / (rz * C1)
    dz = rz - 1.0 / gm7
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * dz) if abs(dz) > 1e-9 else 1e15
    wm = m3.gm / (m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd)
    wcas = mc.gm / (m7.cdd + mc.cgg + 10e-15)
    wc = 2 * PI * ugbw
    ph = 90 + math.degrees(math.atan(wc / wp2) + math.atan(wc / wp3) + math.atan(wc / wm)
                          + math.atan(wc / wcas)
                          - math.atan(wc / (2 * wm)) - math.atan(wc / wz) * (1 if dz > 0 else -1))
    pm = 180 - ph + 7
    slew = 0.8 * min(it / cc, i7 / (CL + cc))
    settle = 1.4 * 0.5 * (0.5 / slew + 4.6 / wc)
    swing = (vdd - vsd7 - mc.vdsat) - m8.vdsat
    power = vdd * (iref + it + i7 + icb)
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300.15
    s_th = 2 * kT4 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m4.gm / gm1)
    KFn, KFp = 2.5e-10, 0.8e-10
    s_fl = 2 * (KFn / (m1.W * m1.L * 1e3) + (m4.gm / gm1) ** 2 * KFp / (m4.W * m4.L * 1e3))
    noise = 1.7 * math.sqrt(s_th + s_fl)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "psrr_db": psrr_db, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "slew": slew,
               "settle": settle, "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise}
